$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A session's ask for a gateway token
description: The answer to asking for an actor's gateway token: that it waits for an Allow in XenoNet's window. It never holds a token, so whoever asks never sees one: the token is made, and shown masked, only in the window.

id.description: actor:<slug>, or @<host>:actor:<slug> from another host; the person at the console is actor:you

request.description: The ask's id, which the window answers with POST /api/actors/requests/<id>

expiresAt.description: When the ask lapses unanswered, in epoch milliseconds

replaces.description: The actor's app has a gateway token already, which Allow replaces
